To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(a) faculty motivation to engage is a complex phenomenon, and (b) faculty motivation to continue to engage in scholarly work is a self regulated learning activity.

self determination theory (SDT) and self esteem theory are two learning motivation theories that provide a useful framework for exploring faculty motivation to engage scholarly work, and that self regulated learning theory can help to explain how motivated faculty maintain their motivation to continue to engage in scholarly work.
faculty motivation to engage research is based on individual rather than institutional needs.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the motivation to engage faculty in scholarly work, as defined by Boyer, that is, research and integration, and not necessarily the motivation to engage them in the production of a concrete product, as defined by Blackburn Lawrence (1995).
faculty motivation to engage and maintain their motivation to participate in scholarly activities.
the motivation to engage and persist in research activities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
faculty scholarly work is the intellectual process that leads to a published outcome.
research is the process of creating and disseminating knowledge.
scholarly work is a process that includes the production of new knowledge and the dissemination of knowledge through a variety of means.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
faculty motivation to engage with research activities is the process through which faculty members engage in scholarly work that leads to a published outcome.
scholarly work includes any scholarly activity that is deemed appropriate to that individuals scholarly development or project| and is based upon the notion that scholarly work is a learning process.
faculty motivation to engage and persist in research activities is a function of the individual's needs and desires to learn and grow in their chosen discipline.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the motivation to pursue scholarly work draws upon the individual's sense of self and their desire to engage in learning.
research, as an activity that leads to a tangible product, is only one aspect of the scholarly process.
the notion of scholarship is a complex, multifaceted, and dynamic activity that is not easily captured in the traditional sense of the term research.
